	["Mark of Perseverance"]={name="Mark of Perseverance", tier=5, use="A rare material that upgrades operator skill mastery.", desc="The perseverance of life and continuation of civilization have left their marks upon this place.", obtain="Reward: Protocol Pass, Acquisition Center: Bond Quota Exchange, Reward: Events"},	["Metadiastima Photoemission Tube"]={name="Metadiastima Photoemission Tube", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A synthetic item for detecting and verifying various field forces and actions at a distance. The tube usually comprises a time crystal sealed in a static vessel, and uses observable regression properties of the photons to achieve its purpose. Though typically stable, users should avoid breaking the vessel and stay out of areas between a pair of linked tubes.", obtain="Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Landfill, Crisis Pandemonium: Rhodagn (Deep Dive), Acquisition Center: AIC Trading, Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills, Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)"},
	["D96 Steel Sample 4"]={name="D96 Steel Sample 4", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A novel and artificial alloy of D32 steel and D64 steel that cannot exist naturally. 	["Tachyon Screening Lattice"]={name="Tachyon Screening Lattice", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="An ion trap that might be leveraging its innate Æther properties. Since the people of Talos-II are still incapable of activating and firing tachyons, the lattice is thus essential for any experiments involving random outcome solidification.", obtain="Protocol Space: Hazardous Material Management Room, Crisis Calamity: Marble Aggelomoirai (Deep Dive), Acquisition Center: AIC Trading, Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: Crisis Drills, Chance Drop: Certain Protocol Space: RE-Crisis (Deep Dive)"},
	["Quadrant Fitting Fluid"]={name="Quadrant Fitting Fluid", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A hypothetical condensed matter in fluid state. Though it could be synthesized and the optical properties of the resulting materials could be observed, the actual structure and state of the fluid have yet to be successfully measured. 	["Triphasic Nanoflake"]={name="Triphasic Nanoflake", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A device that is extremely sensitive to ambient Originium.
